links.evidence: During fiscal 2012, Wal-Mart Stores, Inc. and its affiliates (Wal-Mart) accounted for 22 percent of our consolidated net sales and 30 percent of our net sales in the U.S. Retail segment.
Huawei Technologies Co., Ltd. accounted for approximately 12% , 7% and 4% of our total revenue in fiscal years 2016 , 2015 and 2014 , respectively.
Lenovo Group Limited accounted for 11% of our net revenue (9% in 2011 and 8% in 2010)
